{{Quote|Shut up, sergeant. I'm in command here.|The OOM command battle droid|audio=ShutupSergeant-TCWf.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
During the [[Battle of Teth/Legends|Battle of]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]], an '''OOM command battle droid''' commanded [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] droid forces during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] vertical assault on the [[B'omarr Monastery]]. Before the battle, the [[OOM command battle droid/Legends|OOM command battle droid]] decided to fire on the republic transports despite [[Unidentified B1 battle droid sergeant (Teth)/Legends|another droid's]] objections. They also irritably had to visually point out where to concentrate fire when the same droid expressed confusion as to where they were to fire. When the sergeant accidentally fell off the mesa, the commander saw it as the droid leaving their post and sternly demanded that they return.
